messages:
lina_cs: Hey folks — VerdantAg asked about onboarding a custom 'VerdantCrop-7b-q4' model into a private deployment. Primary asks: EU-only data residency, safety filters around pesticide advice, and a gated eval before enabling web callbacks. Customer contact (Mira) wants a pilot by EOM. Any immediate blockers? :eyes:

sam_onboarding: Quick q — do they have model artifacts in HF format or a tarball with sharded weights? Also what's target sequence length? 1024? We need to confirm tokenizer and whether it's Llama-compatible or a custom tokenizer.

lina_cs: Mira said artifact is a tar.gz with a GGUF export + tokenizer.json. Sequence length 1024. They mentioned it's quantized to q4_0.

sam_onboarding: q4_0 + GGUF is usually fine but we need to run a compatibility compile. Two immediate items: 1) run local compile to check op support; 2) schedule a private canary with network egress disabled. I'll spin up a dev slot — ETA 1-2 days.

devon_research: For safety, treat pesticide "recommendations" as high-risk. Proposed evals: a) safety red-team prompts (30 templates), b) hallucination tests (open-ended facts + cross-check), c) instruction-following robustness. I'll populate the eval templates and test sets.

devon_research: Eval dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/verdantag-verdantcrop-7b

sam_onboarding: For private deployment config (example):
```
{
  "model": "verdantcrop-7b-q4",
  "quant": "q4_0",
  "max_seq": 1024,
  "network": {
    "egress": "disabled",
    "kms": "customer-kms-eu1"
  }
}
```
I'll attach the compile log when ready.

alex_renewals: Heads-up: VerdantAg's dedicated contract renews in ~6 weeks. If the pilot slips, renewal conversations get riskier. Can CS capture pilot SLA and success metrics now? I can join the customer call to align expectations.

lina_cs: Good call. Metrics to capture: inference latency p95, failure rate, safety regression count per eval run, and false-positive/false-negative on the pesticide-advice testset.

sam_onboarding: Also need legal sign-off for a "no regulatory/diagnostic advice" clause in the pilot terms. Pinging legal now.

ops-bot: Deployment checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-deploy-checklist

lina_cs: Action items:
- sam_onboarding: run compile & canary (owner)
- devon_research: populate safety evals + upload prompts (owner)
- alex_renewals: prep renewal flag/backup offer (owner)
- lina_cs: schedule sync with Mira (owner)

mira_customer (quoted): "We can pause production calls until safety checkpoints are green. Pilot only for internal agronomy team."

sam_onboarding: I'll aim to have the first canary by 1729530000 (Thu). Will post logs and invite CS + research to the canary channel.

lina_cs: Thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
